mintAuthority.summary: EURI is issuer-minted/redeemed by Banking Circle. Ethereum and BSC share the same token-owner address and ProxyAdmin. The Ethereum token owner now has EIP-7702 delegated code; the BSC token owner and both ProxyAdmin owners remain codeless EOAs at the pinned observations.

controls.label: Banking Circle issuer-operated mint authority
controls.evidence: Banking Circle materials identify EURI as an issuer-managed MiCA EMT. The token owner and ProxyAdmin owner are separately observed on-chain; the Ethereum token owner has EIP-7702 delegation, while the BSC token owner and both ProxyAdmin owners are codeless EOAs.

controls.label: EURI token owner (Ethereum and BSC)
controls.evidence: Historical owner() reads at Ethereum block 25294735 and BSC block 103620570 returned 0xfCA77c0891578E371ee9Ff34d6f653d8ec3d9e9D with no bytecode. On 2026-10-01, owner() still returned that address at Ethereum block 26095806 and BSC block 125056043. At Ethereum block 26095806 its code was 0xef01000000fb7702036ff9f76044a501ac1aa74cbab16b, an EIP-7702 delegation to 0x0000fb7702036ff9f76044a501ac1aa74cbab16b; at BSC block 125056613 its code remained 0x. No signer threshold or delegation safeguard is inferred.

controls.label: EURI EIP-1967 proxy admin (Ethereum and BSC)
controls.evidence: Historical EIP-1967 admin reads at Ethereum block 25294735 and BSC block 103620570 identified 0xE0c6d43e59eF5C56339214e1dDC9f869805d82eC. Correct-slot reads on 2026-10-01 at Ethereum block 26095806 and BSC block 125056043 still returned that ProxyAdmin. Its owner() returned 0x315ef9e4fECf88B7cFc860d7E995Ff72aD7c7A21 at Ethereum block 26095806 and BSC block 125056613; eth_getCode on that owner was 0x on both chains.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294735 and BSC block 103620570: token owner = EOA 0xfCA77c... (no bytecode on both chains); EIP-1967 proxy admin = 0xE0c6d43e... (same address on both chains), proxy-admin.owner() = EOA 0x315ef9e4... (no bytecode on both chains). All on-chain addressable mint surfaces confirmed across both deployments. Issuer-backend control corroborated by MiCA credit-institution license. Eurite states that Ernst & Young performs periodic attestations, but the reviewed site exposes no dated token reserve examination; its only linked June item is a smart-contract audit. The latest published EY bank financial audit is for December 31, 2024 and does not reconcile EURI supply to reserves, so cadence and latest qualifying report date remain unavailable and reconciliation is unknown. The CSSF source matches Banking Circle S.A. as both a bank and e-money-token issuer, establishing prudential supervision of the issuer despite the assurance gap. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer EOAs can mint or replace mint logic without delay, no dated EURI reserve attestation reconciles supply, and CSSF supervises Banking Circle as the authorized credit-institution issuer. ODR-A6 lane R reconciliation review 2026-09-01: eurite.com publishes no reserve attestation at all. Its full page sitemap is seven pages (/, /regulatory-information/, /privacy-policy/, /download-whitepaper/, /download-our-whitepaper-thank-you/, /contact-us/, /about-us/); /transparency/, /reports/ and /attestation/ each return 404; /regulatory-information/ carries CSSF registration numbers and no assurance artefact; and the live EURI MiCA whitepaper PDF contains no occurrence of 'attest', 'assurance', 'Ernst' or 'EY', its only audit references being Fireblocks SOC reviews and the PeckShield smart-contract audit. bankingcircle.com/euri links three marketing PDFs and no attestation. The homepage's 'attested by a top tier auditor' sentence links no document, and no Banking Circle regulatory-disclosures portal serving monthly EURI attestations could be reached from any primary source. MiCA imposes no public reserve-to-supply reconciliation duty on this issuer: Art. 22 quarterly reporting runs to the competent authority rather than the public, and Art. 58(3) applies Arts. 22-24(3) only to e-money tokens denominated in a currency that is not an official currency of a Member State, so a euro-denominated EMT is out of scope; the only public reserve-audit route, Art. 36(9)-(10), reaches EMT issuers through Art. 58(1) only once an EMT is designated significant, and the EBA has designated no EMT significant. Prudential supervision of Banking Circle S.A. and Art. 54 safeguarding remain the operative constraint, which is exactly what supervision 'prudential' already records; the reconciliation field is a separate fact and is set to the positively-established 'none' rather than left at the unverified 'unknown' (MINT-LADDER 9.32).
